description: The vtable-resolved-evidence pass step 3: vtable-resolved field-access evidence. For each (Class, slotOffset) virtual call resolved by DumpVtableSlots, the target fn is decomped and its param_1 reads/writes are attributed back to the caller via the (Class, slotOffset) -> callerImplVa mapping in virtual_dispatch_queries.json. When a PlayerBase slot has a MyPlayer override, the override is preferred (runtime dispatch goes to the derived class).
